en: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer.

zh: 大衛在洞裏作的訓誨詩，乃是祈禱。

ja: ダビデが洞窟にいたときの黙想の詩。祈り。

p.src: 1  I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

en: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
u.src: 1  I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

p.src: 2  I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

en: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
u.src: 2  I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

p.src: 3  When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

ja: てたときも、 あなたは
en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
u.src: 3  When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

p.src: 4  Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

ja: は一人もいない。 逃げ場は私から消え失せ、 私の魂を気にかける者もいない。
en: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
u.src: 4  Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

p.src: 5  I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

en: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
u.src: 5  I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

p.src: 6  Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

ja: はひどく弱り果てている。
en: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
u.src: 6  Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

p.src: 7  Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

ja: に感謝するためだ。 義人たちは私の周りに集まるだろう。 あなたが
に良くしてくださるからだ。
en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
u.src: 7  Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
